queries_run: Curtiss-Wright business model OR go-to-market OR distribution channel shift 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 描述 CW 銷售對象為 OEM、美國政府／海軍、核電廠與設備商，屬直接銷售的專案／平台型模式；經查未見通路中斷、訂閱化或 D2C 轉型的一手揭露。
findings.excerpt: The commercial aerospace business is primarily impacted by OEM production rates of new aircraft, while the defense business is primarily impacted by government funding and spending on new programs, primarily driven by the U.S. Government.

note: 僅下 1 次搜尋；搜尋未見 2026 通路或商業模式結構性轉變的報導，第三方部落格說法未採用。
